name: Full-skill blind replay of one past NSE session
written: 2026-11-03 IST, before the test day was drawn and before any of its data was read
eligible_why: NSE sessions with Yahoo 5-minute bars on hand (about 60 days back from 3 Nov) and at least 20 earlier sessions for the time machine; 23-30 Oct excluded because test fixtures or the 29 Oct report have shown parts of them; 2 Nov excluded (already revealed).
draw: test_day = eligible_test_days[int(sha256(this file's bytes), 16) % 10]; signal day = the NSE session before it

settings.source: capital, loss per trade, positions, leverage, product, charges and slippage as agreed for the 2 Nov test; daily loss limit and backtest notional chosen by Irfan on 3 Nov

phase_1_signal_day.rule: only data dated on or before the signal day; the screen folder holds no bhavcopy named on or after the test day

nse-backtest.role: context only, does not gate the trades (require_validated is off, as on 29 Oct)

phase_1_signal_day.nse-validate: start on the momentum run; it accepts only a CANDIDATE, so a NO EDGE run is refused

nse-scanner.universe: nifty200 (niftyindices list, last rebalanced end of September)
nse-scanner.daily: scan.py daily --offline on split-adjusted closes built from NSE bhavcopies up to the signal day (the same closes Yahoo's spark gives), --now 'signal day 16:00', defaults
nse-scanner.delivery: scan.py delivery --now 'signal day 18:30', defaults, Nifty 200 only

phase_1_signal_day.watchlist: union of daily and delivery hits, ranked by signal-day turnover (highest first), top 10
phase_1_signal_day.nse-news: Google News RSS per stock, items published in the 72 hours before 09:00 IST on the test day (news.py --offline --now 'test day 09:00' --hours 72 --per-ticker 0); a stock with an item tagged results or SEBI/regulatory in that window is dropped
phase_1_signal_day.nse-analyst: facts.py for each remaining stock, shown only for periods ending on or before 2026-06-30; context only, no gate
phase_1_signal_day.nse-bigmoney: not run: NSE serves only the latest day's bulk/block file, so the signal day's deals cannot be read point-in-time
phase_1_signal_day.nse-shoonya: not run: login works only from Irfan's whitelisted laptop
phase_1_signal_day.lock: the watchlist goes into picks.json, committed and pushed before any test-day bar is read

phase_2_test_day.data: Yahoo 5-minute bars (range 60d) fetched after the lock; every skill call gets bars cut at its own clock
phase_2_test_day.nse-alerts: clock check for the test day; add --from-plan for each plan; check at each event time
phase_2_test_day.nse-entry: check SYMBOL --offline, defaults: 15-minute opening range, first completed 5-minute bar closing above the range high, by no_entries_after
phase_2_test_day.order: triggers processed in time order (ties: higher signal-day turnover first)
phase_2_test_day.nse-exit: plan from entry.json, defaults: stop at the range midpoint, target 2R, flat_by 15:10, MIS
phase_2_test_day.nse-timemachine: run on the stock's bars up to the trigger bar's close; the trade is skipped unless the average R net of charges is above 0
phase_2_test_day.nse-risk: check.py --offline --now trigger time, prices from alerts.py quote; BLOCK = skipped
phase_2_test_day.nse-broker: paper: approve --reply 'yes' typed by Claude under this rule (a replay, not Irfan's consent), working orders filled on bars, track for stop/target, flatten at flat_by
phase_2_test_day.result: net P&L from the paper ledger, then minus 20 bp of every fill's value (slippage); also the Nifty 200 average open-to-close move that day

seen_before_the_draw (late-October facts: TCS closed at Rs 2,530 on 23 Oct, a 20-day closing high (scanner test)
RELIANCE 5-minute bars on 26 Oct around Rs 1,175-1,200 (entry and time machine tests)
29 Oct: 38 of 50 Nifty stocks broke out of their opening range; BEL around Rs 367 (report)
COFORGE, LAURUSLABS, ZYDUSLIFE closed at 252-day highs on 30 Oct (2 Nov screen)
